episodes.title: Never Meet Your Heroes

episodes.summary: Clint has to help Kate disentangle herself from the Tracksuit mafia and a real-life murder mystery.

episodes.summary: Secrets are revealed and hard truths emerge, culminating in a battle against two opposing forces.

episodes.title: So This Is Christmas?
